Section cdc_child:003 (page 4) is Table 3, 'Recommended Child and Adolescent Immunization Schedule by Medical Indication, United States, 2025'. It yielded no rules. The extracted text loses the table's color coding (recommended / risk-based / shared clinical decision-making / precaution / contraindicated / no guidance), so the cell-to-column mapping and recommendation category for each vaccine-condition pair cannot be reliably determined.
The table states 'Always use this table in conjunction with Table 1 and the Notes that follow'. Most cells defer to Notes ('See Notes'), which are not in this section.
Not encoded: 'Tdap: 1 dose each pregnancy'. It needs a per-pregnancy window, which cannot be expressed as a measurement-year window, and its applicability depends on Table 1 and the Notes.
Not encoded: 'HSCT: 3 doses' (Hib). It needs a hematopoietic stem cell transplant history concept that is not in the vocabulary (would be new concept hsct), plus timing from the Notes.
Not encoded: RSV-mAb (nirsevimab) '2nd RSV season' and '1 dose depending on maternal RSV vaccination status (See Notes)'. These depend on maternal vaccination status, RSV season timing and the Notes.
Not encoded: HPV '3-dose series (See Notes)' for some medical indications. The column assignment is unclear (likely immunocompromised/HIV), and the dosing schedule is in the Notes.
Not encoded: Influenza inactivated 'Solid organ transplant: 18yrs (See Notes)'. It is a dosing/product detail that depends on the Notes.

Not encoded: contraindications and precautions. These include 'LAIV3 contraindicated for children 2–4 years of age with asthma or wheezing during the preceding 12 months', the SCID contraindication for rotavirus, and live vaccines (MMR, VAR, HPV marked '*') with 'Vaccinate after pregnancy, if indicated'. Contraindications are not rules under this rule grammar.

Not encoded: HIV CD4 thresholds ('<15% or <200/mm3', '≥15% and ≥200/mm3'). These govern live-vaccine use, would need CD4 lab concepts not in the vocabulary, and point to external General Best Practice Guidelines.

Not encoded: Dengue, Mpox, MenACWY, MenB, Pneumococcal, COVID-19, RSV (Abrysvo) 'Seasonal administration', Hepatitis A, Hepatitis B and IPV by-condition indications. They depend on lost color coding and on the Notes.
Legend categories noted but not encoded: 'Vaccination is based on shared clinical decision-making' (uncomputable), and 'Contraindicated or not recommended' (excluded from rules).
